reviews.text: Our pool was badly damaged after the freeze in February 2021. We had to have all equipment replaced and due to power being out for 50+ hours at our home the water froze in the pool and damaged the plaster causing us to need full resurfacing as well. We had gotten bids from several companies but El Dorado was the only company that was realistic on the repairs we were needing. Not only was their bid fairly priced but they were extremely professional and very prompt throughout the entire process. T
Rico and team do an incredible job, I have never been more satisfied with my pool cleaning and repair. Very consistent and responsive.. best of the best!

I am so pleased with my project with El Dorado Pools.  Joe went above and beyond to get my pool finished on schedule despite significant delays from the  deck company that had to finish before El Dorado could resurface pool and replace tile. Every subcontractor and employee that was sent by El Dorado was extremely professional.  The final project is beautiful and the customer service was exemplary.

We’ve used El Dorado pools for quite awhile and are always pleased with their service . Logan does an excellent job, notifies us when he is coming as we have dogs I want to bring in, and communicates about pool condition and   status. He is thorough and always leaves the area clean, exactly as it was . I would not hesitate to refer Logan and El Dorado Pools!

This is the best pool company in town. Joe and his team know everything about pools. They remodeled my old dirty pool into a beautiful new oasis. Also got the equipment humming. Logan takes care of my weekly maintenance and does a great job. To top it all off, they do a great job communicating and are responsive to any concerns you have. Highly recommended!

We have been using El Dorado Pools ever since our equipment suffered damage during the freeze. They were able to repair everything within a week. Since then, we have our regular weekly service with Conner, and he does a fantastic job. The pool looks beautiful! He even sends us a picture of our closed gate, since we have dogs. I’d highly recommend them for your service.

Eldorado pools has done a wonderful job for us from the start.  Joe came out and gave us and honest evaluation of the work that need to be done and followed through on it beginning to end.  Now that they are our pool services the effort hasn’t stopped.   Conner is on time and efficient at servicing our pool as needed and communicates very well.  This is a great company.

I really appreciate the people that work for El Dorado pools. Logan always does a great job maintaining our pool. If I ever have a concern or question he takes care of it even on weekends. I had guests staying at my house and he even informed them about how to turn on the spa heat. Thank you Logan!

El Dorado Pools is a company of excellence. Joe and his team offer a level of professionalism, knowledge and efficiency that is far above the standard in pool industry   The are excellent in  deign, building, remodeling, equipment repairs  and service.

The Best and always seeking ways to improve

We had struggled finding a pool company to help us manage, repair & maintain our pool.

Joe at El Dorado Pools is AWESOME!  He is quick to return a call, he’s very professional, & we trust what he tells us.

They have taken the worries away for us & for the 1st time, we can enjoy our pool and know it’s in the hands of a professional.

These folks do a great job keeping our pool in top shape. Our tech, Logan, is friendly, reliable, and consistently leaves the pool sparkling, even this time of year with wind and tree debris. Highly recommend!

Highly recommended. Best pool maintenance & services in the DFW area. Moved to TX a few years ago and we've been worry-free since got in contact with Eldorado Pool & Spa. Everyone in the team is so professional & they provided the best value & quality for all service requests. Thank you Joe & April for taking care of us!

Best pool company and service beyond compare!  Jared is truly responsive, and pro-active and I feel like he genuinely cares about my pool!  A pool owner's dream in an often nightmare world.  I've got their weekly cleaning service and I know it is the one thing around my home that's carefree and it's worth every cent in peace of mind.  Definitely would recommend to anyone 100%

Outstanding job! I had a complete re-plumbing job on my pool equipment including new pvc, directional flow valves and multiport valve. Rico was professional, timely and his pricing was fair. He did what he said he was going to do, when he said he would do it and at the price we agreed upon - no hidden surprises. He was respectful and cleaned up the site when he finished.  He was the  cleanest and most professionally dressed pool service\repair company
I have ever used. I highly recommend him to

So courteous and they take time to explain a lot about our pool needs.  We decided to go with them for weekly “brush and balance” service and then had some issues with our pool pump shortly after.  They came out and checked it out quickly (same day) to put us at ease. The pump was making noise but it eventually stopped making the noise. We were told it could be close to its shelf life or it could continue to work for a while but these guys didn’t try to pressure us to replace just to make a quic

El Dorado Pools was fantastic to deal with. Outstanding customer service from beginning to end. They were professional, knowledgeable, did what they said, when they said, at a responsible price. I haven’t had customer service this good in a long time!!

Eldorado Pools completely redid our pool with new plaster and tile. It took nine days including draining and refilling the pool. Joe gave the schedule, and everything went according to plan. Highly recommend.
Eldorado Pools provides outstanding service. Their weekly cleaning and chemical treatments have our pool looking clear! Logan does good work 👍
I highly recommend Eldorado Pools! Thank you Joe for going above and beyond with your help today with the freezing temps! 5 Star company!

I changed to this company back during the deep zero freeze in Dallas in 2021 and haven't looked back since. They even had parts to replace my swimming pool when my existing pool service company did not. They are very personable, easy to speak with, and very responsive. I wouldn't look anywhere else.

reviews.text: Our pool was badly damaged after the freeze in February 2021. We had to have all equipment replaced and due to power being out for 50+ hours at our home the water froze in the pool and damaged the plaster causing us to need full resurfacing as well. We had gotten bids from several companies but El Dorado was the only company that was realistic on the repairs we were needing. Not only was their bid fairly priced but they were extremely professional and very prompt throughout the entire process. They cleaned up each day meticulously and were always on time and on schedule for everything they proposed. The attention to detail and incredible knowledge of all of their staff made a very stressful situation much more relaxed and manageable.  Our pool is absolutely beautiful and I would definitely recommend them for anyone needing any pool repairs, remodeling or pool service of any kind. Every team member takes great care and is very knowledgeable on all pool equipment, pool styles and procedures. They are a fantastic group from top to bottom.
reviews.author: Leann Sumner

reviews.text: Rico and team do an incredible job, I have never been more satisfied with my pool cleaning and repair. Very consistent and responsive.. best of the best!
reviews.author: Carl Hanna

reviews.text: I am so pleased with my project with El Dorado Pools.  Joe went above and beyond to get my pool finished on schedule despite significant delays from the  deck company that had to finish before El Dorado could resurface pool and replace tile. Every subcontractor and employee that was sent by El Dorado was extremely professional.  The final project is beautiful and the customer service was exemplary.
reviews.author: Susan Harbin

reviews.text: We’ve used El Dorado pools for quite awhile and are always pleased with their service . Logan does an excellent job, notifies us when he is coming as we have dogs I want to bring in, and communicates about pool condition and   status. He is thorough and always leaves the area clean, exactly as it was . I would not hesitate to refer Logan and El Dorado Pools!
reviews.author: diane dusek

reviews.text: This is the best pool company in town. Joe and his team know everything about pools. They remodeled my old dirty pool into a beautiful new oasis. Also got the equipment humming. Logan takes care of my weekly maintenance and does a great job. To top it all off, they do a great job communicating and are responsive to any concerns you have. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Lee Chen

reviews.text: We have been using El Dorado Pools ever since our equipment suffered damage during the freeze. They were able to repair everything within a week. Since then, we have our regular weekly service with Conner, and he does a fantastic job. The pool looks beautiful! He even sends us a picture of our closed gate, since we have dogs. I’d highly recommend them for your service.
reviews.author: Suzanne Schumacher

reviews.text: Eldorado pools has done a wonderful job for us from the start.  Joe came out and gave us and honest evaluation of the work that need to be done and followed through on it beginning to end.  Now that they are our pool services the effort hasn’t stopped.   Conner is on time and efficient at servicing our pool as needed and communicates very well.  This is a great company.
reviews.author: Joshua Sumner

reviews.text: I really appreciate the people that work for El Dorado pools. Logan always does a great job maintaining our pool. If I ever have a concern or question he takes care of it even on weekends. I had guests staying at my house and he even informed them about how to turn on the spa heat. Thank you Logan!
reviews.author: Shahdi Jalilvand

data.summary: Google reviews appear authentic and detailed, suggesting a core of very satisfied customers, particularly for major repairs and regular maintenance. However, the anonymized duplicate reviews on the HQ page are suspicious. The significant rating discrepancy with Yelp and Angi indicates potential issues not captured in the provided Google sample, such as service inconsistency or communication problems on other projects. The business has been operating for 24 years, which lends credibility.
fake_signals: Google HQ reviews are anonymized duplicates of Local reviews
Google sample shows only 5-star reviews, creating a skewed positive bias
authentic_signals: Specific project details (freeze damage, resurfacing, equipment replacement)
Multiple employee names mentioned (Joe, Logan, Conner, Rico)
Varied writing styles and specific customer situations (dogs, guests, scheduling delays)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (4.8) and Yelp/Angi (3.3/2.5). Google reviews are overwhelmingly positive and detailed, while lower-rated platforms suggest issues with service consistency, communication, or project management that are not reflected in the Google sample.
